WhoWeAre.title: Who We Are
WhoWeAre.p1: HANY ELARABY & CO (HELCO) is an independent Egyptian firm of chartered and certified accountants and registered auditors, established in 2005. We provide audit, accounting, tax, and financial advisory services to a wide range of enterprises and companies across many industries.
WhoWeAre.p2: From our offices in Cairo and Dubai, we serve clients across Egypt and the MENA region — from family-owned businesses and growth-stage startups to publicly listed corporations and government entities. Our approach combines deep technical expertise with practical business understanding to deliver reliable, compliant, and value-creating outcomes.
WhoWeAre.p3: We are committed to the highest standards of professional ethics, quality, and independence. Our multidisciplinary teams work as trusted advisors, helping clients navigate complex regulatory environments, strengthen governance frameworks, and make informed financial decisions.
WhoWeAre.estDesc: Over 20 years of institutional audit and advisory experience
WhoWeAre.menaDesc: Offices in Cairo and Dubai serving clients across the region
WhoWeAre.teamDesc: Chartered accountants, certified auditors, tax specialists, and strategists
WhoWeAre.regDesc: Deep understanding of Egyptian, GCC, and international compliance frameworks

OurLeadership.title: Our Experts
OurLeadership.p1: At HELCO, our greatest asset is our people. We boast a dynamic, fast-growing team of high-caliber audit specialists who are continuously elevating industry standards. Guided by top-tier professionals holding prestigious international certifications, including the IFRS Diploma, our experts ensure absolute financial compliance and precision.
OurLeadership.p2: Driven by a culture of continuous learning, our team members are actively expanding their expertise through advanced ACCA qualifications. As our firm rapidly expands, we consistently attract and onboard top talent to deliver innovative, world-class financial solutions to our clients.
OurLeadership.pillar1Desc: International certification held across our senior audit leadership
OurLeadership.pillar2Desc: Team members actively advancing through professional qualification
OurLeadership.pillar3Desc: A culture of technical development embedded in every engagement
OurLeadership.pillar4Desc: Consistently attracting and onboarding top regional talent
